subject.why: The ship matches the brief closely, including the red hull, masts, sails, slipway splash, and dolphin figurehead.

category.why: Low camera angle with a clear base of water and slipway anchored across the bottom.

clean.why: Free of UI elements, text, borders, and characters.

framing.why: The ship is well-centered with ample breathing room on all sides except the grounded base.

colour.why: Bright, saturated palette with strong contrast between the red hull and blue environment.

detail.why: Clean shapes and chunky splash geometry without noisy micro-textures.

style.why: Consistent 3D cartoon finish with soft lighting and smooth satin surfaces matching the references.
